model_selection: V2 architecture historically selected on validation; external test weights and 0.5 threshold frozen.
aggregation: 100-nonspace paragraph merge; ~600-character internal windows; character-weighted document score; paragraph-count ratios separate.
overlap: Exclude both local detectors' known fitting/development/validation text and propagated source-family matches; also known XLM-R training matches. No semantic/pretraining guarantee.
limitations: Old-source holdouts are source-familiar to V2.
MAGE full training exposure and Base pretraining are not fully audited.
Input formatting and genre vary; results do not isolate generation architecture causally.
AI-only collections have no binary F1, AUROC, or human FPR.
Some older records are pre-cut detection units, not complete original articles.
